instruction:
Fix `packages/element/src/textStyles.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Two open security findings (Gate 3 re-review). (1) SVG paint injection: sanitizeStyleColor and sanitizeStyleHighlight (lines ~36-75) check colorToHex(trimmed) !== null but return the raw trimmed string; tinycolor2's rgb/hsl matchers are unanchored, so "url(#x) rgb(1,2,3)" and 'rgb(1,2,3)" onload="x' both give colorToHex === '#010203' and the raw payload reaches <rect fill>/<tspan fill>. Change both to RETURN the canonical `colorToHex(trimmed)` (never the raw string), keeping the checks: typeof string, trimmed.length <= 64, colorToHex(trimmed) !== null, !isTransparent(trimmed). In sanitizeStyleColor, the clear-when-equal-to-stroke rule must compare canonical forms: `const baseHex = baseStrokeColor !== undefined ? colorToHex(baseStrokeColor.trim()) : null; if (baseHex !== null && hex === baseHex) return undefined;`. (2) Uncapped loops: element.textStyles set via updateScene/API (not restore) can be any length. At the START of getUniformTextRangeStyle (~line 326), shiftTextRangesAtOffset (~382-470) and splitTextIntoStyledSegments (~543-557), slice the input to `ranges.slice(0, MAX_TEXT_RANGES)` (when ranges is defined) before any per-entry work, exactly as normalizeTextRanges already does; use the sliced array everywhere in each function. Change nothing else.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.

## Answer
Return ONLY a JSON object {"path": "packages/element/src/textStyles.ts", "edits": [{"search": "<text copied exactly from the current text>", "replace": "<its replacement>"}]} with no other text. Each search must appear exactly once in the current text; the edits apply in order.
If the file does not exist yet, or the change rewrites most of it, return {"path": "packages/element/src/textStyles.ts", "content": "<the complete file>"} instead.
